newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-DRAKES AND POLLOCK DOMINATE AT KINGSMEAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-DRAKES AND POLLOCK DOMINATE AT KINGSMEAD.

text.p: Border, and Shaun Pollock, for Natal, dominated the second day's
play in their four-day Supersport Series cricket match at
The 26-year-old Drakes took centre stage first to finish
with impressive figures of 8-59 as Natal collapsed to 332 all
out after beginning the day on a commanding 315 for five in
Although Natal captain Dale Benkenstein (129 not out) and
Pollock (59 not out) were well established at the crease, Drakes
took five wickets for only seven runs as the Natal lower order
Benkenstein was removed without further addition in the
third over of the day attempting to hook a short delivery while
Pollock was bowled through the gate by a Drakes off-cutter for a
Drakes finished off the Natal innings with a mixture of
short-pitched deliveries and an intelligent change of pace.
In reply, Border batted sketchily on a good pitch with the
main resistance coming from Frans Cronje (42) and Mark Boucher
Pollock, bowling for Natal for the first time since his
ankle operation in August, maintained excellent control to take
3-35 in three spells. Although not bowling at full pace, he
occasionally fired in a quick delivery and got through his
But the batting highlight of the Border innings was an
authoritative cameo of 41 in just 34 balls from Drakes. Striking
the ball powerfully through the on-side, Drakes smashed six
fours and a straight-driven six off the slow left-arm of Anthony
Botha efore being caught behind trying to avoid a Benkenstein
By the close, Natal had reached 22 without loss in their
second innings for an overall lead of 149.
